subject.title: Unified env var management: .env should be the single source of truth

question: Should ordinary managed Gateway restart re-stage provider env values from `~/.openclaw/.env`, warn and route users to doctor repair, or remain a pure supervisor restart with clearer docs?
rationale: The choice changes credential precedence and generated service-env preservation across launchd, systemd, and Windows tasks; recent fixes show both stale values and over-regeneration can break real users.

options.title: Warn and offer repair
options.body: Keep restart mostly a supervisor action, but detect managed env drift and direct users to an in-product doctor/fix path that can re-stage safely.

options.title: Re-stage on restart
options.body: Make `openclaw gateway restart` rebuild managed service env from state-dir `.env` across supported supervisors with tests for preserved non-`.env` secrets.

options.title: Document current precedence
options.body: Leave restart behavior as-is and make service-env precedence and repair commands explicit in public docs.

recommendation.title: Warn and offer repair
recommendation.body: Keep restart mostly a supervisor action, but detect managed env drift and direct users to an in-product doctor/fix path that can re-stage safely.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent service-env planning and co-authored generated-file SecretRef preservation work make this the best routing candidate for the policy choice.
